:::{#def-inner-product-definiteness}
#### Definiteness

A function $\iprod{\cdot}{\cdot}$
that assigns a real number to each ordered pair of vectors in $\reals^p$
has **definiteness** if

$$
\iprod{\vx}{\vx} = 0
\quad\text{if and only if}\quad
\vx = \vzero_{p \times 1}
$$

for all $\vx \in \reals^p$.

:::
